trigger: validator, launcher, wrapper, or operator command fails

steps.action: Preserve the failed worktree and local evidence; do not clean unrelated state.
Classify the failing boundary: routing, syntax, CMD/native argument transport, PowerShell wrapper, validator, artifact resolution, or runtime.
Repair the canonical owner rather than bypassing the gate or weakening a fixture.
Add a minimized positive or negative regression fixture or executable boundary test.
Rerun the actual outer entrypoint and require the canonical artifact.

failurePolicy: An inner script pass cannot close a failure observed at an outer launcher or shell boundary.
proofCeiling: Repair and rerun evidence for the observed boundary only; no target-runtime promotion.
